# tonaly

> Immersive ear training studio designed for musicians and audiophiles. Develop absolute note recognition, master relative intervals, and unlock deep performance insights.

## About
- Immersive ear training studio designed for musicians and audiophiles. Develop absolute note recognition, master relative intervals, and unlock deep performance insights. Part of the BERVOS ecosystem (https://bervos.org).
- Author: Bernardo Lares (https://bervos.org)
